app_store.name: Reelplain: Reels & Carousels
app_store.subtitle: Clip, caption, know the cost
app_store.promotional_text: Every action shows its cost before you tap it. Failed renders give your credits back. Cancel in one tap.
app_store.description:
Reelplain turns your videos and photos into reels and carousels, and shows you what each step costs before it runs.

How it works:
- Drop in a video or a few photos
- Reelplain drafts clips or a carousel with captions
- Change anything on your phone, then export or post

What's different:
- The cost is on the button, before you tap
- If a render fails, your credits come back automatically
- Anything you make can be exported, even on the Try plan (with a small watermark)
- Cancel in one tap. You keep your plan until the period ends
- Full editing on your phone: trim, caption text, caption position
- Your footage stays yours: no AI-generated replacements unless you ask
- Save caption styles you like, or turn captions off

Plans:
Try: 10 credits a month, watermark.
Creator: 120 credits a month, no watermark.
Studio: 400 credits a month, 3 brands, bulk export.
Unused credits roll over for one month. We email you before every renewal.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
